note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: normDiv and divPsi give the bases f0..f4, the even and odd recurrences with D0 = 16(x^3+Ax)^2, psi_n = f_n or 2y f_n and psi_{-n} = -psi_n; divPsi_eq_Ψ identifies them with the classical (Mathlib) division polynomials. mulByN_formulas_of_charZero gives [n]P = O iff psi_n = 0 and x([n]P) = x - psi_{n+1}psi_{n-1}/psi_n^2, y([n]P) = psi_{2n}/(2psi_n^4) over any characteristic-zero field; w_mul_cw is psi_{2n} = psi_n c_n with c_n = 2omega_n, whose quotient form follows from w_even.

theorem mulByN_formulas_of_charZero {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] [DecidableEq K] (A : K)
    {x y : K} (h : (WA A).toAffine.Nonsingular x y) (n : ℤ) :
    (n • Affine.Point.some x y h = 0 ↔ psiEval A n x y = 0) ∧
    (n • Affine.Point.some x y h ≠ 0 →
      ∃ h' : (WA A).toAffine.Nonsingular
          (x - psiEval A (n + 1) x y * psiEval A (n - 1) x y / psiEval A n x y ^ 2)
          (psiEval A (2 * n) x y / (2 * psiEval A n x y ^ 4)),
        n • Affine.Point.some x y h = Affine.Point.some _ _ h') := by
